name: Setmore
description_en:
Setmore is an appointment scheduling service with a public Booking Page, staff calendars, customer records and payment integrations. It offers Free and Pro plans, so the selection question is which operating capabilities a business needs beyond accepting a booking.

Its billing definition of a user is a staff profile/calendar, including a calendar without login permission. SMS is credit-based, not an unlimited reminder entitlement. These distinctions affect cost even when appointment volume is unlimited.
description_zh:
Setmore 是带公开 Booking Page、员工日历、客户记录和支付集成的预约服务，提供 Free 与 Pro。因此选型重点是企业除接收预约外，还需要哪些运营能力。

其用户计费定义为员工档案/日历，包括没有登录权限的日历。短信按额度计费，不是无限提醒。即使预约次数不限，这些区别仍影响成本。

core_features.explanation_en: Expose services, available times and team profiles for customer booking.
core_features.explanation_zh: 展示服务、可用时间及团队档案供客户预约。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro includes two-way calendar synchronization and recurring appointments.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 包含双向日历同步及重复预约。

core_features.explanation_en: Country and message segmentation determine credit use; exhausted credits stop sending.
core_features.explanation_zh: 国家及消息分段决定额度消耗；额度耗尽后停止发送。

en: Create staff profiles, define services and working hours, then expose a Booking Page or website widget. A customer selects a service and available staff time. Inspect the staff calendar, customer confirmation and payment record if payment is required. An owner-managed staff calendar still counts as a user even when the staff member cannot log in.
zh: 创建员工档案、服务及工作时间，再开放 Booking Page 或网站组件。客户选择服务及员工可用时间；如需付款，应对照员工日历、客户确认及付款记录。即使员工不能登录、日历由所有者管理，该日历仍计为用户。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Free up to four staff calendars; annual Pro per-calendar/user subscription with metered extra SMS and separate processor/receptionist costs.

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 最多四个员工日历；Pro 按日历/用户年订阅，短信增量、处理及人工接听另计。

sections.title_en: Example: a service team with separate calendars
sections.title_zh: 示例：拥有独立日历的服务团队
sections.en:
Create staff profiles, define services and working hours, then expose a Booking Page or website widget. A customer selects a service and available staff time. Inspect the staff calendar, customer confirmation and payment record if payment is required. An owner-managed staff calendar still counts as a user even when the staff member cannot log in.

Test a staff holiday, a full slot and a customer cancellation. Free and Pro both list unlimited appointments and group classes, but deposits, recurring appointments, video appointments and two-way calendar sync are Pro capabilities in the comparison. Verify each desired flow on the selected plan.
sections.zh:
创建员工档案、服务及工作时间，再开放 Booking Page 或网站组件。客户选择服务及员工可用时间；如需付款，应对照员工日历、客户确认及付款记录。即使员工不能登录、日历由所有者管理，该日历仍计为用户。

建议测试员工休假、时段已满及客户取消。Free 与 Pro 均列出不限预约及团体班课，但比较表把订金、重复预约、视频预约和双向日历同步放在 Pro。应在所选档位核对具体流程。

sections.title_en: 500 credits do not mean 500 messages everywhere
sections.title_zh: 500 额度不等于各地区 500 条消息
sections.en:
The SMS guide allocates 500 monthly credits per team member for web Pro, with mobile-subscription bands described separately. A US/Canada SMS uses one credit, while UK/Australia use five; segmentation can multiply consumption. The guide lists 160 characters for plain English and 70 with emojis/special characters or non-English text per segment.

If both included and purchased balances are empty and auto-reload is off, reminders stop. Included credits do not roll over; one-time purchases last six months while monthly bundles expire with the cycle. Auto-reload can charge the stored payment method when the balance falls below ten percent. Check delivery and usage rather than equating a saved reminder configuration with a sent message.
sections.zh:
短信指南为网页 Pro 每位成员每月分配 500 额度，移动订阅另有档位。美国/加拿大短信每条一额度，英国/澳大利亚五额度，分段还会增加消耗。指南列出纯英文每段 160 字符，含表情/特殊字符或非英文每段 70 字符。

包含及购买余额都耗尽且关闭自动补充时，提醒停止。包含额度不结转；一次购买有效六个月，月度包随计费期到期。低于百分之十时，自动补充可能向已存付款方式扣款。应检查送达及用量，不能把保存提醒设置等同于消息已发送。

sections.title_en: Staff seats, annual rates and optional call answering
sections.title_zh: 员工席位、年付费率与可选接听服务
sections.en:
Free supports up to four users at zero subscription charge. The pricing page labels Pro at $5 per user per month with annual billing; a separate $12 figure also appears in the text, so verify the selected monthly/annual checkout rather than infer a universal rate. No currency code or final tax total was confirmed in the extracted page.

The live receptionist is a separate US-only service, advertised from $99 monthly, and is not the scheduling subscription. Pro starts billing on signup with automatic renewal; the FAQ describes a 30-day refund request policy rather than a guaranteed free paid-plan period. Payment-processor charges and extra SMS purchases are separate decisions.
sections.zh:
Free 最多四位用户，订阅费为零。定价页将 Pro 每用户每月 $5 标为年付，文本中还出现 $12，因此应核对具体月付/年付结算，不推定通用费率。读取页面未确认货币代码或最终含税总额。

人工接听是独立的美国地区服务，宣传每月 $99 起，不属于排程订阅。Pro 注册即开始计费并自动续费；FAQ 描述的是 30 天退款申请政策，不能当作付费档必然免费使用。支付处理费及额外短信是独立成本决策。

sections.en:
Service managers should prepare staff calendars, opening hours, cancellation policy and required booking fields before enabling payment or SMS. Diagnose a missing slot through availability and calendar access; diagnose a missing text through credits, destination and segmentation. This research did not run those tests.

A branded mobile app is described as adding the Booking Page to a home screen, not proof of a separately developed native customer application. The managed web/mobile product does not establish self-hosting or open-source redistribution rights. Health-related entitlements and BAA suitability need their own agreement and account checks.
sections.zh:
服务负责人应先准备员工日历、营业时间、取消政策及必填字段，再启用付款或短信。时段缺失应检查可用性与日历访问，短信缺失应检查额度、目的地及分段。本文未执行这些测试。

品牌移动应用被描述为把 Booking Page 加到主屏幕，不能证明有单独开发的原生客户应用。托管网页/移动产品不赋予自托管或开源再分发权。医疗相关权益及 BAA 适用性需合同与账户另行核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Final currency/monthly checkout, processor fees, SMS delivery, privacy/BAA, export, licence and recovery were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试最终货币/月付结算、处理费、短信送达、隐私/BAA、导出、许可及恢复。
